svg.title: Two generals problem
svg.desc: A driver app and the dispatch service talk through a tunnel that loses messages. First they chase certainty: accept, confirmed, got it, and the fourth message vanishes, so neither side is sure. Then the fix: the app sends accept ride 812 with request a91f, the reply is lost, the app retries with the same ID, dispatch recognizes a91f, assigns nothing new, and the second confirmation arrives.
svg.text: The last sender never knows. Neither side is sure.
Phase 2: retry with the same request ID
Same ID, so the retry is harmless
Every ack needs its own ack. A retry with the same ID makes doubt harmless.
